title: Fix SPH mesh pipeline push-constant range (VUID 10069)
purpose: Resolve SPH pipeline creation warning/error by matching push-constant block size to shader usage.

steps.detail: Set SPH pipeline push constant range to sizeof(SPHMeshPushConstants) for both mesh and fragment stages.
Ensure SPH shaders do not include extra fields beyond the struct; or increase range accordingly.
Alternatively, gate SPH pipeline creation with a flag until mesh path is stable.

acceptance: No VUID-10069 during SPH pipeline creation
SPH pipeline either disabled or created cleanly
